n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize combination array C
C = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
C[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

# Initialize w and dp arrays
w = [0] * (n + 1)
dp = [0] * (n + 1)

w[0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        current = C[i - 1][j - 1] * w[j - 1] % mod * w[i - j] % mod
        w[i] = (w[i] + current * (i + 1)) % mod
        part1 = (dp[j - 1] * w[i - j] + w[j - 1] * dp[i - j]) % mod
        part2 = ( (i - j) * (i - j + 1) // 2 + j * (j - 1) // 2 ) % mod
        contribution = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * part1) % mod * (i + 1) % mod
        contribution = (contribution + current * part2) % mod
        dp[i] = (dp[i] + contribution) % mod

# Initialize w2 and dp2 arrays
w2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 2)]
dp2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 2)]

w2[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 2):
    for k in range(m + 1):
        for j in range(1, min(i, k + 1)):
            pi = i - j - 1
            pk = k - j
            cw = C[k][j]
            w2[i][k] = (w2[i][k] + cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j]) % mod
            temp1 = cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * dp[j] % mod
            temp2 = cw * dp2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j] % mod
            dp2[i][k] = (dp2[i][k] + temp1 + temp2) % mod
        # Accumulate sums
        if i > 0:
            dp2[i][k] = (dp2[i][k] + dp2[i - 1][k]) % mod
            w2[i][k] = (w2[i][k] + w2[i - 1][k]) % mod

print(dp2[n + 1][m])
